name: Word of Critical Healing, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 8, druid 9, shaman 8, witch 9

This spell functions like mass word of light healing except that it heals 4d4 + 1 per two caster levels to all creatures (maximum +20).
